meta.title: ci: add cargo caching to pre-commit workflow
meta.body_summary: Add Rust dependency caching to pre-commit workflow to speed up CI checks, later switched to rust-cache action per reviewer suggestion.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added manual caching; maintainer suggested rust-cache action, Devin switched, merged quickly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 22 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small CI optimization PR that merged quickly after adopting a maintainer suggestion.

review_details.concern_detail: cprussin asked if there's a risk when bumping toolchain versions and forgetting to update the hardcoded cache key, and suggested using the Swatinem/rust-cache action for more sophisticated caching without manual version management.
review_details.performance_claim: Speed up pre-commit CI checks by caching Rust dependencies and build artifacts.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple CI workflow change with low technical barrier; Devin successfully integrated a reviewer-suggested alternative action using a mature community action.

detection_detail.code_reading: cprussin reviewed the cache key and noted the risk of stale version numbers, then suggested using the Swatinem/rust-cache action for robust caching.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No runtime performance data; only a claim that caching will speed up CI.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression; the reviewer feedback was a design improvement suggestion that was implemented without delay.

core_change_summary.description: Add Rust dependency caching to ci-pre-commit.yml, first manually with actions/cache then switched to Swatinem/rust-cache action to eliminate manual version management.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added manual caching step with hardcoded toolchain versions in cache key.
After reviewer asked about version update risk, Devin replaced with Swatinem/rust-cache action, removing manual cache key management.
